target_process: Coda wave interferometry theory; velocity-change estimation from coda time shifts
dvv_amplitude: sensitivity grows with lapse time t (dt = -t·dv/v)
uncertainty_treatment: variance of time shift from cross-correlation; statistical theory of multiply scattered waves
best_practice_note: Foundational theory: relative travel-time shift in the coda equals -dv/v (uniform medium); coda waves amplify small velocity changes because dt accumulates with lapse time

target_process: dv/v monitoring via passive image interferometry (stretching)
uncertainty_treatment: max correlation-coefficient grid search (10,000 trials over ±3%); accuracy ~0.1%
best_practice_note: Introduced the stretching (PII) method: grid-search the stretch factor maximizing CC between stretched daily autocorrelation and reference; single station suffices

target_process: Ambient-noise preprocessing (normalization, whitening) for reliable correlations
freq_band_hz: whitening band stated (e.g. 5 Hz-100 s periods)
uncertainty_treatment: SNR-based quality control; error analysis on dispersion measurements
best_practice_note: Canonical 4-phase preprocessing workflow: (1) single-station prep with time-domain normalization (one-bit or running-mean) + spectral whitening, (2) cross-correlation & stacking, (3) measurement, (4) SNR-based QC

target_process: Stability/validity of passive (noise-correlation) monitoring vs active source
uncertainty_treatment: demonstrates dv/v stable even when full Green's function not reconstructed, provided noise sources stable
best_practice_note: Velocity-change monitoring does NOT require a fully reconstructed Green's function; it requires temporally stable noise sources and stable correlation waveforms

target_process: dv/v error estimation / resolution & accuracy of MWCS
stack_scheme: current stack vs reference, weighted linear regression dt vs t
uncertainty_treatment: formal MWCS errors: coherence-weighted phase-delay errors per window; error inversely proportional to SNR; least-squares slope error on dt/t
best_practice_note: Established MWCS error framework: dv/v from weighted linear fit of dt vs t with coherence weighting; measurement error scales inversely with SNR

target_process: Precision/bias of the stretching method (dv/v error theory)
uncertainty_treatment: analytic RMS error of stretching estimate as function of coherence/decorrelation, bandwidth and coda window; closed-form error formula
best_practice_note: Derived the precision of the stretching estimate: dv/v error depends on loss of coherence between reference and current correlations, the frequency bandwidth, and the coda time window

target_process: Improving temporal resolution of dv/v monitoring (waveform clustering)
stack_scheme: waveform clustering to enhance daily stacks
uncertainty_treatment: clustering reduces noise-source variability; resolution improved from 30 days to 1 day
best_practice_note: Waveform clustering of correlations (grouping by similar noise-source conditions) raises temporal resolution from ~30 days to 1 day while preserving dv/v accuracy

target_process: Depth sensitivity of coda waves to velocity perturbations
depth_sensitivity: early coda = surface-wave (shallow) sensitivity; later coda = body-wave (deeper) sensitivity; partition ratio quantifies mix
best_practice_note: Coda depth sensitivity is a lapse-time-dependent mix of surface- and body-wave contributions; early coda samples shallow, late coda samples deeper; higher frequency = stronger scattering = better deep observation

target_process: Spurious dv/v from temporal changes in ambient-noise frequency content
uncertainty_treatment: identifies systematic (non-random) bias from non-stationary noise spectrum; recommends checking noise-source spectral stability
best_practice_note: Temporal variations in the ambient-noise frequency content produce SPURIOUS apparent dv/v; must verify noise-spectrum stationarity (or restrict to stable bands) before interpreting velocity changes

uncertainty_treatment: implements Clarke et al. 2011 MWCS errors; reproducible parameter database
best_practice_note: Open, reproducible end-to-end Python workflow (DB-driven) standardizing preprocessing, CCF, reference-stack and MWCS dv/v with documented parameter choices

uncertainty_treatment: compares accuracy of WCC vs stretching vs DTW; DTW more robust at low SNR
best_practice_note: Introduces Dynamic Time Warping for coda phase-delay estimation; DTW recovers a full local time-shift vector and outperforms windowed cross-correlation when SNR is low

target_process: Denoising correlations (curvelet filtering) to improve dv/v temporal resolution
uncertainty_treatment: curvelet denoising reduces dv/v uncertainty, enabling 1-day resolution
best_practice_note: Curvelet-transform denoising of daily correlations removes incoherent fluctuations while preserving coherent coda, enabling daily-resolution dv/v from short stacks

authors_year: Daskalakis, Evangelidis, Garnier, Melis, Papanicolaou & Tsogka 2016
target_process: Robust dv/v estimation insensitive to noise-source seasonality (normalization)
uncertainty_treatment: shows seasonal noise-source fluctuations create apparent dv/v; adequate CCF normalization removes this bias
best_practice_note: Apparent seasonal dv/v from non-uniform/seasonal noise sources can be suppressed by proper normalization of the cross-correlation functions

depth_sensitivity: 3-D kernels: penetration depth increases with lapse time; quantitative surface/body-wave partition
best_practice_note: Provides 3-D lapse-time-dependent depth sensitivity kernels: select the coda lapse-time window according to the target depth — later coda probes deeper

authors_year: Wang, Brenguier, Campillo, Lecointre, Takeda & Aoki 2017
target_process: Stacking strategy & reference choice for stable nationwide dv/v
stack_scheme: compares stacking schemes; long reference stack for seasonal trends
uncertainty_treatment: demonstrates reference-stack and stacking-length choice control the apparent long-term trend and seasonal amplitude
best_practice_note: Reference-stack and stacking-window choice bias the recovered seasonal/long-term dv/v; use a long, representative reference and consistent stacking to compare across stations/regions

target_process: Review: seismic time-lapse interferometry methods across scales
depth_sensitivity: depth proxy via frequency band & coda lapse time
uncertainty_treatment: synthesizes error sources: noise-source variability, processing choices, sensitivity kernels
best_practice_note: Review chapter consolidating best practice: choice of dv/v method, frequency band (depth), coda window, reference, and the dominant error sources across application scales

uncertainty_treatment: offers multiple dv/v estimators so users can cross-check; parallel/HDF5 reproducible pipeline
best_practice_note: High-performance Python package implementing multiple normalization, stacking and dv/v methods so practitioners can benchmark estimator choices; ~4x faster correlations vs MSNoise

target_process: Review of ambient-noise dv/v monitoring methods & perspective
uncertainty_treatment: reviews uncertainty/bias sources and method trade-offs
best_practice_note: Brief review enumerating method trade-offs (stretching vs MWCS vs wavelet/DTW), processing pitfalls and the influence of noise-source and processing choices on dv/v

target_process: Benchmark comparison of dv/v measurement methods (time/freq/wavelet)
uncertainty_treatment: quantifies accuracy/robustness of 7 estimators vs SNR, perturbation size, heterogeneity; wavelet methods handle cycle-skipping
best_practice_note: Comprehensive benchmark of 7 dv/v estimators: stretching robust for uniform changes and low SNR; cross-spectral/MWCS suffers cycle-skipping at large dv/v; wavelet-domain methods give best joint time-frequency accuracy
